title: My Home
text:
My house is small and blue. It has two bedrooms, a kitchen and a living room.

In the living room there is a sofa and a big table. My cat sleeps on the sofa every day.

questions.text: How many bedrooms does the house have?
What is in the living room?
options: A sofa and a big table

questions.text: Why is the cat probably comfortable in the living room?
options: It has a sofa to sleep on

questions.text: What kind of person most likely lives in this house?
options: A person who likes animals and a comfortable home
A person who never sits down
A person who has no furniture

vocabulary.definition: a long soft seat for two or more people
a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs

paragraph_translations: Мій будинок маленький і синій. У ньому є дві спальні, кухня та вітальня.
У вітальні є диван і великий стіл. Мій кіт щодня спить на дивані.
